reason: A read-only Figma integration that provides bounded design-node inspection and temporary renders for agents before implementation.

summaries.zh: 这是一个只读 Figma 集成插件，可为智能体提供受限的设计节点检查结果和临时渲染链接。
summaries.en: A read-only Figma integration that gives agents bounded design-node inspection results and temporary render links.

capabilities: Reads bounded Figma file and node data through the Figma REST API
Inspects layout, typography, paints, component references, and variable bindings
Generates temporary render URLs for selected Figma nodes
Uses a host-provided Figma personal access token
